description: Save the learner's grade and, optionally, their exam date and daily problem target for that grade, so later calls default to that grade and get_study_plan uses that date. Side effects: creates the learner's account on first use and REPLACES the saved grade (and the saved exam date or daily target for that grade, when given) with these values. Practice history is not touched. Safe to retry: the same values give the same result.

dailyQuestions.description: Problems per day for the study plan, if the user gives one

exam.description: Exam (grade) id to save, e.g. "ca-d2"; get_exam_overview lists the ids

examDate.description: Exam date as YYYY-MM-DD, if the user gives one

timeZone.description: The user's IANA time zone, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles", if known; sets which day counts as today in the plan

name: save_study_settings
title: Save study settings
